query_text: 我们大概二十个人想找个能一起吃团建饭的地方，有没有很适合大型团体聚餐的餐厅？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐厅能否顺利接待二十人左右的大型团体，大家是否能坐在一起好好用餐。
evidence_span: Came in with a group of 20ish people a little after the new year and it was great! We dined family style, and the food was very promptly brought out, and each of us had enough to eat
evidence_context:
Came in with a group of 20ish people a little after the new year and it was great! We dined family style, and the food was very promptly brought out, and each of us had enough to eat (plus almost everyone took a to-go container or two, or three, as well). All the food was delicious (and the to-go containers even had reheating instructions, very helpful).

The stand out experience though was when someone poured a drink on me before walking out (due to the conversation, not the food)- the server was RIGHT THERE with a handful of napkins to dry off with, I was very impressed! And they were also very patient as my party collected the payment from everyone as well, which was quite an issue with 20+ people. Great place for large groups.

query_text: 计划办一场十二人左右的聚餐，找一家空间够大、接得住大团体的餐厅有什么推荐？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐厅确实能接纳十二人及以上的团体，并安排好座位共同就餐。
evidence_span: I had a party of 12, called a few days in advance, and they accommodated both us and several other groups in their dining room that same evening.
evidence_context:
The details listed above are for their OLD LOCATION. At their NEW LOCATION AT THIS ADDRESS, they have tons of space! It's GREAT FOR GROUPS, they have WAITER SERVICE, TAKE RESERVATIONS and it's BYO. If you bring tequila, they'll hook you up with salt and some awesome margarita mix. 

I had a party of 12, called a few days in advance, and they accommodated both us and several other groups in their dining room that same evening. The ambience is relaxed, the waiters were attentive without being bothersome and the food was, as always excellent. Best of all, we felt comfortable hanging out for hours and no one bothered us. AND they don't have TV's and keep the music fairly low - we could all actually hear each other but since it's so group friendly we didn't feel like we were bothering anyone if we did get a little loud. 

Highly recommended for groups!

query_text: 十二个同事想凑一桌吃饭，哪里的餐厅能坐得下我们这么大的团体？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐厅是否真的能把大团体安排在一桌正常用餐。
evidence_span: When we arrived they had us at 2 separate tables, we were promised one table for our group.
evidence_context: Horrible service for good but overpriced Chinese food.  I had takeout from here once prior to dining in the restaurant and it was good but I did find it to be more expensive than other Chinese restaurants. When planning a holiday gathering with colleagues, we decided on Han Dynasty because it was a BYO and the gentlemen who we spoke with on the phone had assured us they could accommodate our group of 12.  When we arrived they had us at 2 separate tables, we were promised one table for our group.  We waited for some time but no one brought us menus, we had to go get them ourselves from the hostess stand. Our tables were not set either.  We also had to ask for ice and glasses, and our server seemed rather annoyed by this request. Throughout the meal our water was never freshened and once our ice was gone that was it.

query_text: 六个人以上一起去吃饭，想找一家不会把大伙儿晾在一边、能好好接待团体的餐厅
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐厅对六人以上的团体是否招待到位、能否顺利入座用餐。
evidence_span: NOT ACCOMMODATING TO LARGE GROUPS!!!! Do not go if group is 6 or more! Forgot about us for 2 hours even though we went up every 20 minutes to check in.
evidence_context: NOT ACCOMMODATING TO LARGE GROUPS!!!! Do not go if group is 6 or more! Forgot about us for 2 hours even though we went up every 20 minutes to check in. Manager was rude and did not care.
